### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**1** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **15** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 397572ed5da04c14eed7b4bf934a4c353822df6c` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `1a837a47a89ce61422cf7e9ee94cb3e318325e40` — the merge of head `32de5e64fc63ff51fe5bf3ae28dd49c1c04b2993` into base `397572ed5da04c14eed7b4bf934a4c353822df6c`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 1a837a47a89ce61422cf7e9ee94cb3e318325e40 && git checkout 1a837a47a89ce61422cf7e9ee94cb3e318325e40
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 397572ed5da04c14eed7b4bf934a4c353822df6c 32de5e64fc63ff51fe5bf3ae28dd49c1c04b2993 && git checkout -B drift-repro 397572ed5da04c14eed7b4bf934a4c353822df6c && git merge --no-ff 32de5e64fc63ff51fe5bf3ae28dd49c1c04b2993

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 397572ed5da04c14eed7b4bf934a4c353822df6c
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `32de5e64fc63ff51fe5bf3ae28dd49c1c04b2993`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #20507 (body; comments 5879479871 triage grade, 5880083725 claim, 5880534492 os-dev-report), PR #20527 (body; the 4-file list, +117/-15; the net diff against `main` at 397572ed5d), and the check-runs on the head. Binding direction: triage's grade 5879479871 under ADR-0045 §3 ("Hidden" means externally unobservable, consistently across every surface; "REST/MCP calls against a unpublished app return 404 by default").

Check-runs on the head at my read (23:28 UTC): 32 runs — 22 success, 3 skipped (Build Docs, Console Pin Gate, Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)), 7 in progress (Test Core 1/6, 2/6, 4/6, 5/6, 6/6; Type Check · workspace; Lint & Repo Gates), 0 failure. Success includes Build Core, Type Check · source gates, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · debt ledger, Test Core (3/6), Dogfood Regression Gate (1/3, 2/3, 3/3 and the aggregate), Dogfood Verify CLI, Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL), Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check PR Size, Flag docs affected by code changes, and the four claim/close guards. The 7 running checks are recorded as running; no verdict is inferred for them.

### ① Derived judgments

The diff: one source change. `createMetaLayeredAnswer` in `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` gains a step 1 — `present = META_ITEM_LAYERS.filter(layer != null)`; when `present.length === 0` it answers `{ kind: 'refuse', refusal: { reason: 'absent' } }` before the gate. The former steps 1 and 2 (gate, mask) are the pre-fix code moved verbatim with `present` hoisted out of the gate block; the docblock's "with nothing behind the name the protocol answers every layer null, and so does this chain" sentence is replaced. `rest-server.ts` and `runtime/src/domains/meta.ts` are untouched, which the claim's file surface allowed only if a transport needed a line — none did (both already map `absent`).

1. A member, an absent name against an unpublished app, both spellings, both transports — RIGHT: the same status and body now. RestServer: both refusals reach `sendMetaReadRefusal` → `sendMetaItemAbsent` (404, `{ error: { code: RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND, message: "Metadata item not found or access denied." } }`; the message names no item); the flag's `Deprecation` and `Link` are written on `res` before `serveMetaItemLayered` runs, so they ride both answers. Dispatcher (`answerMetaLayered`): both are `withHeaders(deps.error('Not found', 404), headers)`. The unpublished app's refusal is the gate's `absent` (now step 2), the absent name's is step 1; the emitter is the same object on each transport, so the two bodies cannot diverge. No `Vary` (the view is not translated) and no `Cache-Control` (owed on serve only) on either. Pinned by the new describe: 2 transports × 2 spellings, comparing status, code, body, Vary, Cache-Control, Deprecation and Link with the requested name masked — the mask is right, since Link names the caller's own request path, not the item.
2. A published item's answer, and a builder's answer for an unpublished item — RIGHT: unchanged. Any present layer makes `present` non-empty, and steps 2–3 are the pre-fix steps 1–2 unchanged. `launchpad` for `builder` (`studio.access`) has `effective` non-null → the gate admits → 200, pinned on both spellings and transports by the new "whoever asks" case; the four published-app controls pin the member's served body (every layer pruned to `nav_leads`, `nav_org_directory`), and the pre-existing `[#20478]` layered census still drives every item cell × probe × caller through `sameAnswer` across transports.
3. H0, the reader — RIGHT: the search supports "nothing depends on the 200". Re-measured on objectui at the pinned `.objectui-sha` dd3f7e1b (git grep over the local sibling clone's objects at that commit; no checkout). `MetadataClient.layered` (`packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts` 1289–1304) is the only wire reader of `/layers`; on `res.status === 404` it returns `{ code: null, overlay: null, overlayScope: null, effective: null }`, and its own comment already reads a 404 as "an empty-but-successful layered view". 15 non-test call sites in 5 files, exactly the dev's list (ResourceEditPage 1017, 1510, 1649, 1689, 1723; StudioDesignSurface 1820, 1949, 2962, 4015; EmbeddedItemEditor 110; PermissionMatrixEditor 512, 841, 885; PackageOwdOverviewPanel 155, 249); each reads `effective ?? code ?? {}`. The protection verdicts: `editable !== false`, `deletable !== false`, `lock && lock !== 'none'`, and `resettable ?? isArtifactItem` where `isArtifactItem` requires `layered.code != null` — false for an absent name, the same verdict the old 200 carried (`resettable = artifactBacked`, false with no code layer). `ResourceEditPage`'s load effect returns early in `createMode`. `PermissionMatrixEditor` 834 states the 404 shape as its designed path. No `?layers=` in objectui non-test source (CHANGELOG hits only; control: the client's own `/layers` URL at 1301). SDK: no `layers` hit in `packages/client/src` or `packages/client-react/src` (control: 26 `/meta` hits in `packages/client/src/index.ts`); the route ledger row `GET /api/v1/meta/:type/:name/layers` is `disposition: 'server-only'`. In-repo in-process readers of `getMetaItemLayered` (plugin-security) call the protocol, not the chain, and are untouched. QA: the dogfood suites read `/layers` and `?layers=true` for existing items only (`crm_order`, `showcase_account`); http-conformance has no layered read.
4. The two edited existing tests — RIGHT: intent kept, no assertion weakened. (a) Parity `?package=` case: the one removed assertion (`payroll?package=crm` → 200, code null, effective null) pinned exactly the defect's answer. It is replaced by `crm?package=elsewhere` → 200, `code: null`, `effective.label` 'CRM (overlay)' — `crm` is `_packageId: 'crm'`, so the scope empties its code layer while the env overlay row still answers, which is the original intent ("?package= scopes the code layer") shown with the overlay surviving — plus `payroll?package=crm` → 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND (a scope that leaves no layer is the name's absence, never a 200 with every layer null). The invoice mask assertion is untouched. (b) Census `metaProtocol` double: only the fixture changes — `getMetaItemLayered` now answers `{ code: doc, overlay: null, overlayScope: null, effective: doc }` where the generic `{ ok, rows, ... }` answer carried no layer; the `/layers` row's `SERVES_ON_ITS_OWN` assertion `toBe(200)` is unchanged and now measures a real document through the gate and the mask rather than an all-absent pass-through, which is the row's stated intent ("serves on its own reading").

Also judged right: a `?package=` scope that leaves no layer answers 404 (the code layer is scoped away under ADR-0048 and no overlay row exists, so the name resolves to nothing in that scope; the client already treats that 404 as empty). In-process, `createMetaLayeredAnswer`'s `serve` for a no-layer input becomes `refuse/absent`; its only callers are RestServer and the dispatcher, both of which already write `absent`. The absence is judged before the gate exactly as the plain read's step 1 (#18066) judges it, so a name with nothing behind it cannot be converted into a 403 either. Nothing wrong found.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/20507-layers-absent-name-oracle.md`: `"@objectstack/rest": patch`. Matches what the diff publishes: one source file in `@objectstack/rest`; `@objectstack/runtime` changes a test file only and takes its wire change through the shared chain, which the changeset body names on both transports. A bug fix in a released package takes `patch` (AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist 3); the card is `bug` + `security`, the fix pulls a door back to the declared contract (ADR-0045 §3), removes or renames nothing an author writes, and the body carries the client note ("treat that 404 as the same answer"; Studio's client already maps it). `Clause-②: no`, no arm, in both the PR body and the changeset body — truthful: no accept set is widened and no public surface grows; a response is withdrawn, not an input narrowed. Check Changeset on the head: success. Level right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: none.
- Out-of-scope finding — `GetMetaItemLayeredResponseSchema.effective` describe text ("null when the item resolves to nothing at all", `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts` 507–511): answered. The text still describes the protocol method's in-process return, which is unchanged (plugin-security reads it in-process and still gets nulls); on the REST wire that case is now the route's 404. `packages/spec/**` is read-only on this card. Escalated to the spec seat as a describe-precision item; not a landing condition.
- Deviation, `os-verify-lock.sh` UNLOCKED (no flock on macOS): a declared narrowing; the head's check-runs are the gate verdicts, not the dev's local runs.
- Deviation, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` NOT MEASURED: the diff changes no import, export or module format; Build Core on the head is success.
- Deviation, first label-write exit 3 then re-run: process noise, nothing was written twice; no bearing on the diff.
- Deviation, `qa/http-conformance` and `qa/dogfood` not run locally: neither reads the layered view for an absent name (grep above); Dogfood Regression Gate 1/3, 2/3, 3/3 and Dogfood Verify CLI are success on the head.
- Deviation, no labels written: none were dispatched.
- Reviewer note: Console Pin Gate on this head is skipped; the diff removes no export the pinned sibling imports, so nothing is owed there. 7 check-runs were still in progress at my read (listed above); the landing waits on them as on any head — recorded, not inferred.
